correctness.rationale: Explicit scalar invariant diagonal dynamics yields exact kappa=2delta/sin delta with unique delta by strict monotonicity. Derivative matrix is I-h cos(delta)K at both orbit points; eigenvalues are computed from K=I+J, and 0<2delta cot delta<2 on the stable range establishes the sharp all-mode spectrum. At pi both matrices equal identity; above pi all eigenvalues exceed 1. IFT persists a hyperbolic two-cycle under independent positive edge weights. Independent numerical eigenvalue/transition replay passed 15 sampled combinations.

value.rationale: The 2026 source identifies h=2/(n+1) as the sharp failure of global Lyapunov descent, leaving dynamics beyond it undetermined for stars with at least four leaves. The new exact post-descent interval of an attracting phase-oscillation with a second sharp pi endpoint, full transverse Floquet spectrum and robustness under weight heterogeneity gives a natural, quantitatively complete bifurcation fact for that very model. It is not merely a scalar 1D flip because the complete network attracting/repelling type and robustness require all transverse modes; no global attractor classification is claimed.
